why: Pretty but sleepy with Juniper: all blush, peach and sage, with no forest green and no hot pink, so the tiles do all the work.
Has her pink lotus and leaf greens, but bright sky blue and periwinkle take over, and blue isn't in Juniper; busy next to her faces.
Closer than expected: forest green, coral-pink and white marbling echo her backs and faces. The all-over swirl is busy under tiles.
A real contender: hot pink and coral blooms with deep forest and kelly greens on a light ground. The blue birds are the only off note.

Good on green: a deep forest jungle like her backs, with a blush sky. Very little hot pink, and darker and moodier than her bright faces. Neoprene shows sold out on Britt Mills; the leatherette is in stock.
Not a fit: navy and plum ground, purple and magenta peonies, orange accents. There's no forest green, and the purple fights her pink.
Half there: the lime and kelly fretwork border picks up her layers, but the navy pagoda centre is a blue Juniper doesn't have, and there's almost no pink.
A real contender: hot pink frame, pink and coral peonies, green leaves and a mint lattice centre that echoes her mint layer. A close cousin of Lotus Cove.
Bold and works: a hot pink ground with green-and-white palms, like Palm Royale turned up. The magenta leans a touch purpler than her OMM Hot Pink rack.
Just okay: the centre is a muted grey-sage, not her forest green, and the floral border runs more coral-red than pink.
Mixed: the mint centre and pink blooms suit her, but orange poppies, yellow and royal blue flowers pull it tropical-rainbow, away from her pink and green.
Not a fit: mostly white with pink, yellow, orange and blue dabs and very little green to tie in her backs. The photo is a close-up crop (the only one we have).
Not a fit: greige centre with a ditsy navy, red and pink border and almost no green. Shows sold out on Britt Mills.

Soft and pretty: the sage frame and pink peonies suit her, but it's very pale, the dark backs would sit on a nearly white centre, and blue birds aren't Juniper colours. The brand photo is a flat mockup.
